crypto_keylength_justification: The project uses standard TLS/SSH library defaults and no legacy algorithm override. Audited Python3.12/OpenSSL defaults require TLS1.2+,128-bit-or-stronger symmetric encryption and ephemeral exchange. Private local plaintext protocols must be isolated; operators manage trusted endpoint certificates/host keys. Source-specific scope is documented at https://github.com/4alvit/mqtt-observability-opentelemetry/blob/main/SECURITY.md
